items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: He was quite a fan of ours and when I came back home, he came back all the way down to New Orleans to hear me play again, he told me.

ctx.x: That's something that's really awful here, you know.

You probably know, it's Paul Edouard Smith, or is it Edouard Smith? Charles Edouard. Charles Edouard Smith, yeah. He was quite a fan of ours and when I came back home, he came back all the way down to New Orleans to hear me play again, he told me. He liked my little register so much. He had some job for the government, wasn't it in Washington?
He was writing for the Department of Agriculture.
